customManagers.description: The bootstrap CI image is a reusable-workflow INPUT (`with: image:` in .github/workflows/bootstrap.yml), which the github-actions manager cannot see (it reads `uses:` only). Bump the dated Tumbleweed snapshot tag from registry.opensuse.org (#150). The regex versioning admits only pure YYYYMMDD tags, so `latest` and the per-build `20260901.37.150` tags are ignored.

packageRules.description: Date-tag bumps for the Tumbleweed CI image: ci(bootstrap) commits, no digest (rebuilds within a snapshot share VERSION_ID, so a digest PR changes nothing the probe cares about), and automerge once the bootstrap gate itself is green — the registry prunes date tags after ~6 weeks, so a bump PR left sitting would eventually fail every PR with `manifest unknown`.
